scope: Same-store application reset/reload with drained access and explicit HA recovery hooks; production ingress/member integration pending
nativeScopeNote: Native smoke tests pending-intent startup/restart and API publication persistence. Same-object reload is tested by Lisp suites and heap probe; HA member/recovery callbacks are test doubles, not production WAL coordination. Fake runtime; no root/container/BPF execution.
memoryMode: Cached compilation. Capture/validation/materialization retain source; reload resets source application fields, performs GC, loads target on same object, reopens access and checks1024 resources plus a64KiB payload. Does not retain two full application indexes or exercise active-cluster ingress drain.
coverage: Every store slot explicitly classified for reset or retention
Same store identity, locks, member config, actual signing-key object/file and consensus callback preserved
Application/watch state and derived credential/projection/certificate caches reset
Reload and recovery-ack failures retain intent and blocked access; same-object retry works
HA requires synchronous member barrier and durable recovery callback; reload proposes no commands
Post-reload consensus Pod write persists in selected generation across reopen
Intent unlink sync failure cannot reopen access even when intent is already absent
remaining: Node RPC/controller/external-reference ingress quiescence before production live invocation
